message.content:
1. (HIGH) — Appendix B / Physics critic
   Finding: Physics critic correctly identifies R410A compressor selected for R290 system, violating BS EN 378-1 and creating explosion hazard.
   Evidence: "The Copeland ZP25K5E-TFM is an R410A scroll compressor, not rated or safe for R290 (propane) refrigerant."
   Root cause: Module 5 compressor selection stage in chain-v2 (no refrigerant-chemistry guard in class-standards or parts resolver).
   Fix: Add explicit R290-only filter in compressor lookup + cross-check against Copeland YP/ZP-R290 series before emission.

2. (HIGH) — Section 6 BoM + Cost Stack
   Finding: Multiple critical power components priced 5-20× below real distributor cost, collapsing total BoM to £1,508.
   Evidence: "IGBT Power Stage Infineon FS150R12KT4 £28.47"; "DC Link Capacitor ... £0.49"; "Scroll Compressor Mechanism ... £113.20".
   Root cause: Engine B price curve (0.080–0.265 multipliers) applied without volume-tier or class-specific floor for power electronics / compressors.
   Fix: Insert per-class min-price table (compressor ≥£380, IGBT ≥£95, large caps ≥£18) before scale factor 0.325.

3. (HIGH) — Section 2 Module 5 / Physics critic
   Finding: DC-link capacitance of 20 µF is electrically insufficient for 2.5 kW inverter, causing >5 % ripple and capacitor failure.
   Evidence: "The DC link uses two 10 µF capacitors ... For a 2.5 kW motor drive, 20 µF is extremely insufficient."
   Root cause: Power conversion sub-module generator lacks ripple-current / capacitance sizing rule from physics critic.
   Fix: Add 100–330 µF minimum rule + recalculation step in inverter PCB sub-module before BoM emission.

4. (MED) — Section 2 Module 6 / Physics critic
   Finding: EMI filter (Schaffner FN2030-6-06) rated 6 A but compressor draws ~10.9 A continuous.
   Evidence: "The Schaffner FN2030-6-06 EMI filter is rated for 6 A. However, the 2.5 kW electrical compressor draws approximately 10.87 A."
   Root cause: Mains input sub-module uses generic choke lookup without load-current validation against compressor electrical rating.
   Fix: Add current-rating guard (≥16 A) tied to compressor kW in power_distribution module.

5. (MED) — Section 1 Brief & Section 2 Regulatory
   Finding: Brief claims A7/W35 performance and MCS 020 <56 dBA but report never declares explicit test conditions or noise calculation output.
   Evidence: "To comply with MCS 020 planning requirements, the outdoor unit features extensive acoustic damping to maintain sound power below 56 dBA."
   Root cause: Brief parser accepts narrative claims without mapping to BS EN 14511 / MCS 020 test-point fields.
   Fix: Force explicit A7/W35 + MCS 020 dBA fields in brief ingestion and propagate to acoustic and performance modules.

6. (LOW) — Appendix A / G5 part numbers
   Finding: 60+ fabricated or mismatched part numbers remain after verification pass (e.g., ZP25K5E-TFM, OEM-IMM-3KW-14, GRILLE-500-STEEL).
   Evidence: "60 part numbers could not be verified against DigiKey / Mouser / Farnell / web".
   Root cause: Parts resolver still emits LLM-invented SKUs; post-fix class-suppliers alias only partially constrains manufacturer namespace.
   Fix: Enforce strict manufacturer + catalog lookup whitelist before any custom-OEM fallback.
